plain: The businessman Bob Bigelow is said to believe that alien craft have also crashed in Russia, China and South America, and that "they're seeding them around the world." The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels that a man named Timothy Taylor asked Bigelow whether other countries had had crashes and got this answer, which would mean crashed craft are being left for many nations to find.
